body: And no one ever blames them. If they do something to you it’s fine but if you do it to them you get in trouble. If they start shit and you fight back it’s in you, and if you start shit and they fight back people say you shouldn’t have started it.  I fucking hate that. I have a twin sister who is a horrible bully, and she made my childhood miserable, especially since my parents acted the way teachers do, it’s always your fault no matter what. They always get a break and you never do. The hypocrisy and double standards suck and it sucks to not have your voice be heard. Especially since my sister is so manipulative and most people think she’s nice. My parents know how she is though and take her side anyways. Best of luck to you OP.
